subject: [AMBER] Question about the 'softcore part' of outputfile in pmemd

messages.author: wangjianing_mail
messages.body:
Hi,
Here is a question that can be answered in one sentence.
When I use ‘ifsc=1’, ‘softcore part of system’ information will be output in ‘| TI region 1’ of the output file, such as SC_Etot, SC_14NB, etc.
Is this information completely equal to, under the same conditions, the independent single point calculation of the softcore part?
Thanks in advance!
Best,
Jia-Ning Wang
